The domain of $\operatorname{arccos}⁡(x)$ is $x\in [-1,1].$  

Now, substituting $x=-\frac{1}{2}$ directly into the limit, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{lim}_{x\to \,-1/2}\operatorname{tan}⁡(\frac{1}{2}\operatorname{arccos}⁡(x)) & =\operatorname{tan}⁡(\frac{1}{2}\operatorname{arccos}⁡(-\frac{1}{2})) \\  & =\operatorname{tan}⁡(\frac{1}{2}\cdot \frac{2\pi }{3}) \\  & =\operatorname{tan}⁡(\frac{\pi }{3}) \\  & =\sqrt{3}.\end{aligned}
$$
